maddeler.e:
اقتلعن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعْنَ (iqtalaʕna) /iq.ta.laʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعْنَ (uqtuliʕna) /uq.tu.liʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اِقْتَلِعْنَ (iqtaliʕna) /iq.ta.liʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
